title: Using this manual
intro: The **User Manual** button is on every screen. It opens the manual for the screen you are on — each section of the system has its own. Ask a question in your own words or pick a topic. Help only shows the way — it never changes anything.

topics.title: How to use the User Manual
questions: How do I use this help?
What can I ask the user manual?
topics.summary: Click **User Manual** (bottom right of every screen). It opens the manual for that screen — for example the **Hotel Rates** manual on Hotel Rates. Type a question such as *Where do I approve hotel rates?* and press **Ask**. The answer gives numbered steps and a button that opens the right screen.

steps.text: Click **User Manual** at the bottom right of the screen. The name of the manual that opens is under **User Manual** at the top of the panel.
Type your question in plain words and press **Ask** (or Enter).
Follow the numbered steps. **Bold** words are the exact names of screens and buttons.
Use the purple button in the answer to open the right screen. Opening a screen changes nothing by itself.
Where two manuals share a screen, choose one under **Manuals for this screen**. **Other manuals** at the bottom of the panel opens the rest.

notes: If the manual has no checked answer, it says so instead of guessing.
An answer from another manual is marked *from the … manual*.
So far there are manuals for **Hotel Rates** and **Hotel Master**. Other sections are being added.

topics.title: Printable manual (PDF)
questions: Where is the printable user manual?
Can I download the manual as a PDF?
How do I print the user manual?
Where is the full manual with all sections?
topics.summary: Each manual has its own printable PDF, made from the same instructions as this help, so both always match. At the bottom of the **User Manual** panel: **View PDF** or **Download PDF** for the manual that is open, and **Full manual (all sections)**.

steps.text: Click **User Manual**, then **View PDF** at the bottom of the panel to read or print the manual that is open; **Download PDF** saves it.
For every section in one PDF, use **Full manual (all sections)** at the bottom of the panel.
Click **Download** next to it to save a copy.

topics.title: I cannot open a screen (no permission)
questions: I do not have access to a screen
Why do I get forbidden or 403?
How do I get permission for a menu?
topics.summary: Each menu entry is a permission given to your user group. Ask your manager; the System Administrator gives it under **Settings → Group Privileges**. Log out and in again afterwards.

steps.text: Note the screen name you need (the manual shows it, for example **Hotel Rate Approval**).
Ask your manager. If it is agreed, the System Administrator adds it under **Settings → Group Privileges**.
Log out and log in again so the new permission takes effect.
